groupings.title: Support inbox
groupings.description: Read and answer customer conversations, triage the inbox, look up customers, and manage feature requests, the changelog and help center articles through the relay CLI, MCP server or REST API.

groupings.title: Chat widget
groupings.description: Add the Superrelay live chat widget to any website or web app, identify signed-in users and verify their identity on your server.

groupings.title: Help center
groupings.description: Keep your help center in the repository as Markdown: write articles, then check, diff and push them to Superrelay.

groupings.title: Releases
groupings.description: Turn the commits since your last tag into a changelog entry, link the feature requests it ships and notify their voters.
